best_idea: Give every HUD message a countdown that the text itself sets (a floor plus a per-character reading time), and count it down on the clamped frame step so a hitch slows it instead of skipping it.
decision_why: Keep the length-based countdown and the clamped-step tick; use Frankendom's own constants, count characters not bytes, guard the zero-max bar, and reject the executable string loader (copyright and not our shape).
acceptance: At 375 px wide, a 60-character toast stays visible at least 3.0 s and a 5-character toast at least 2.5 s (Playwright timing check), and a 500 ms stall moves the countdown by at most 66.7 ms.
